question: Which new, minimal, reproducible cases exist where hp-sim5 returns wrong results or violates its own stated invariants? Deliver a smallest-possible reproducer plus quantitative evidence for each genuine incorrect behavior. Exclude encoder autocalibration entirely (a separate parallel program owns it).

agents.question: Probe the Rust cable/physics core for wrong results: degenerate cable geometry, NaN/Inf propagation, tension/sign conventions, constraint residual, and world-isolation or reset-state leaks. Produce a smallest reproducer plus quantitative evidence.

Hunt for wrong results in the firmware and motion-command layer: Klipper/RRF emulation, G-code parsing, feedrate and step quantization, encoder bookkeeping, queue/limit edge cases. Compare emulator output against exact analytical motion where possible. Produce a smallest reproducer plus quantitative evidence.

Hunt for wrong results in machine geometry, scene/config loading, unit handling and the forward transform: inverse/forward round trips, anchor and spool geometry, catalog presets, malformed or boundary config values. Produce a smallest reproducer plus quantitative evidence.

Check cross-backend and state-lifecycle correctness: Wasm vs native vs Python physics parity for identical scenes, determinism across repeated runs, reset/reconfigure state leaks, and multi-world isolation. Produce a smallest reproducer plus quantitative evidence.

Fuzz the pure numerical and geometry helpers for invariant violations: quaternion, vector3, geometry3, planar_math, inertia_tensor, and any JS spool/cable wrap math. Check orthonormality, inverse consistency, positive-definite tensors, angle wrapping, degenerate inputs. Produce a smallest reproducer plus quantitative evidence.

Verify end-to-end kinematic correctness for every catalog machine: command pure +X/+Y/+Z moves through the production command path and check effector displacement direction and magnitude against the authored geometry; check motor sign, spool winding direction, steps-per-mm and line-length monotonicity per axis. Produce a smallest reproducer plus quantitative evidence for any mirrored, scaled or dead axis.
